newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania, Germany start military exerecise.
newsitem.headline: Albania, Germany start military exerecise.

text.p: Albania and Germany began their first joint military exercise on Thursday which will train troops in helping people after natural disasters.

"This bilateral training shows the excellent military relations between Albania and Germany and the friendship between our countries, governments and armies," Albanian Defence Minister Safet Zhulali said.
He noted that the beginning of the 10-day exercise, conducted under NATO's Partnership for Peace initiative, coincided with the anniversary of German unification.
"Today we are not only thinking but also acting together for peace and justice," Zhulali said.
The troops, mainly engineers, have set up camp in the Patok Beach region 60 km (40 miles) northeast of Tirana -- a site of regular flooding during the autumn.
A small Albanian peacekeeping unit is currently stationed with German troops in Croatia as part of the NATO-led forces implementing the Bosnia peace accord.
